pair.email_hint: Enter the email address of a NOTTY Smart Pet account (the app you use to control your Revoloo). NOTTY will email you a login code.
pair.code_hint: Check your email for the code from NOTTY.
pair.code_required: Enter the code from the email
pair.one_login_title: NOTTY allows one login per account
pair.one_login_tip: Logging in here logs that account out of the NOTTY app. Use the account that owns the litter box: a shared account can only view it. Tip: share the litter box in the NOTTY app with a second account (another email address) and use that one on your phone.
pair.session_expired: Your NOTTY login has ended, probably because you logged in elsewhere with the same account. Please log in again.

device.offline: The litter box is offline according to the NOTTY cloud
device.login_expired: NOTTY login expired. Use 'Repair' on this device to log in again.
device.cat_not_found: This cat was not found in your NOTTY account
device.view_only: This NOTTY account is shared with you, so it can only view the litter box. Log in to Homey with the account that owns the litter box: open the device in Homey and choose Repair.

settings.title: Diagnostics
settings.intro: The latest data the NOTTY cloud sent to this app. Useful for reporting problems or adding support for new devices.
settings.copied: Copied. Paste it in your message or GitHub issue.
settings.empty: No data yet. Add a device first and wait a minute.
settings.privacy: Email addresses, tokens and device serial numbers are hidden. Check the text before you share it.
